sloka: किम् व्ख्स्यामो महाबाहुरनसूयः प्रियम्वद ।नीतः स राघवोऽस्माभिर्ति वक्तुम् कथम् क्षमम् ॥२-४७-९॥
transliteration: kim vkhsyāmo mahābāhuranasūyaḥ priyamvada ।nītaḥ sa rāghavo'smābhirti vaktum katham kṣamam ॥2-47-9॥

translations.english: What shall we say (to the people)? How can we say, 'We have conducted him (to the forest), that scion of the Raghus, that mightyarmed Rama, who is of gentle speech and free from malice?
